title: Step-touch

steps.text: Stand tall with your feet together and your knees soft.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring the other foot in and tap it beside the first.
steps.cue: Bring the other foot in and tap.

steps.text: Go back the other way. Let your arms swing gently in time.
steps.cue: Now the other way. Arms swing gently.

mistakes: Stepping so wide that you lose your balance.
Looking down at your feet the whole time.
regression: Take smaller steps, and leave your hands on your hips.
stopIf: Stop if you feel dizzy, sick, very short of breath, or any pain in your chest.

anatomy.why: Stepping sideways uses the outside and inside of the hips, which walking forward hardly touches.
